brief: Maths Standard start (root request, 18 November 2026), methods of brief 243
purpose: Research route inputs for Claude, not a canonical route or teaching approval
syllabus: Mathematics Standard 11-12 (2024), Year 12 Standard 2 and Standard 1
identifierPolicy: Exact CMS codenames; official sourceHtml preserves mathematical layout. Year 12 entries list Standard 2 and Standard 1 codenames separately (standard2ActionIds, standard1ActionIds); syllabusActions carries both, each with its course.

officialEvidence.source: NSW Curriculum Year 12 Standard 2 Trigonometry and Standard 1 Right-angled triangles pages, as recorded in the crosswalk (read 18 November 2026)

siteSource.note: Paths are repo paths at this commit, read from the read-only local clone C:/Users/kygs/teaching-app-fix at the same commit (not modified). SHA256 values recomputed from the clone on 18 November 2026 and match the crosswalk inventory. All eight Trigonometry lessons and Year 11 Applications of measurement lesson03 use data-step-id sections and label worked examples we-1 to we-3 (lesson04 also we-4). Lessons 01 to 05 are titled Year 11, Module 2 on the page (MS-44); they are the Year 12 trigonometry lessons.

recommendations: Run t01 to t11 after Ratios and rates and before Bivariate data (root rulings 28 and 46). Standard 2 students take all eleven. Standard 1 students take t01 to t05 (their Right-angled triangles focus area), then go to math-s12-b01; t06 to t11 are Standard 2 only.

Playlist order: ruling 46 puts r01 to r14 before t01 to t11 and supersedes the outline table's numbers, so this file uses the ruled positions: a01 to a13 = 1 to 13, i01 to i23 = 14 to 36, r01 to r14 = 37 to 50, t01 to t11 = 51 to 61 (split parts share their number). Outline problem: maths-standard-route-inputs-4.json and the outline JSON still give r01 to r14 as 48 to 61 and t01 to t11 as 37 to 47; the r13 design cites 'playlist order 60'. Root to confirm the renumbering and correct those two files (b01 stays 62).

Joins: t01 opens on the house roof triangle that ends r14 and r13's Standard 1 panel (ruling 45); the roof angle is confirmed at 35° (ruling 55: the site's own trigonometry hook angle; r14 already speaks it; the 'not to scale' tag covers the painted 24°), so r13 and r14 can be voiced once the t01 design confirms it. t05 ends on a two-route frame (Standard 2 to t06's river; Standard 1 to b01). t10 opens on r07's radial-survey sketch and closes r08's rainfall loop (ruling 43). t11's final frame is b01's opening picture, identical to t05's Standard 1 panel (proposal: a beach kiosk's board pairing daily top temperature with ice creams sold, the site's bivariate lesson04 example; provisional until the b01 pack exists).

Outline problem (entry knowledge): the brief asks for 'Year 11 Standard right-angled trig points', but the 2024 Year 11 Standard course has none (Applications of measurement stops at Pythagoras, cib49e1f1d). The outline's dependency list (Pythagoras and changing the subject) is right; t01 introduces sin, cos and tan from the start, which is why it is flagged at risk.
Pace flags (gentler Standard pace): t01 at risk (suggested split t01a and t01b); t03, t05, t08 and t10 to watch; t02, t04, t06, t07, t09 and t11 fit 6 to 9 minutes.

Advanced reuse (ruling 7): kit and plates from the Year 11 Advanced trigonometry videos (StudioTriangle, ElevationView, BearingRose, BearingJourney, HingeBars, StudioCirclePoint, MinutesDial) cover most visuals; Advanced anchors are not reused (a yacht under a cliff and at sea, fire lookout towers, a garden bed, a phone tower's range, a sandwich and a pool rack, a flying fox). Site worked examples that happen to share an Advanced object (the site's yacht, cliff and garden bed) keep their numbers on coded diagrams only. The drone (Advanced a12-d12, a camera-tilt rate) and the entrance ramp (Advanced w10's gradient) are flagged where the packs use their plates.

Site findings: MS-41 to MS-46 appended to docs/production/claude-pm/site-corrections-maths-standard.md, section 8 (five last-digit rounding slips, one quick-match option, a misleading depression-angle sentence, Year 11 labels on five Year 12 pages, two methods heavier than Standard needs, and gaps for Year 12 Pythagoras practice, named compass directions and constructing a radial survey).

Kit needs for this strand are in docs/production/claude-pm/checks/maths-standard-kit-needs-t.md; the main new part is a RadialSurvey board (field book to rays, angle arcs, the 360° ring, area chips with a running total and a boundary), with MapPins for landmark bearings and small readout options on the existing Advanced parts.
covers: math-s12-t01 to math-s12-t11 (Year 12 Trigonometry, Standard 2, and Right-angled triangles, Standard 1)

entries.startBoundary: Opens on the final frame shared by r14 (Standard 2) and r13's Standard 1 panel (rulings 45 and 53): the house plate with the coded right-angled roof triangle, 35° at the eave, '?' on the height, the grey tag 'not to scale'. Roof angle confirmed at 35° (ruling 55): it is the site's own trigonometry hook angle and r14 already speaks it.
entries.stopBoundary: Label O, A and H from a chosen angle; why a ratio of two sides depends only on the angle (any 35° right-angled triangle has opposite ÷ hypotenuse ≈ 0.5736); sin, cos and tan (SOH CAH TOA); choose the ratio from the two sides involved; unknown on top and unknown underneath, with the 'hypotenuse is longest' check; an angle given in degrees and minutes typed as degrees + minutes ÷ 60; degree mode; round at the end. Finding an angle is t02.
entries.recommendation: The 2024 Year 11 Standard course has no trigonometric-ratio point, so this video introduces sin, cos and tan from the start. Keep the site's 15 sin 32° = 7.95 cm, 9 ÷ cos 48° = 13.45 m and 18 sin 38° = 11.08 m; lesson02 we-3's ladder is 5.14 m, not the site's 5.15 (MS-41). Roof anchor: a 5.5 m slope at 35°, height 3.15 m, run 4.51 m. Pace: at risk; suggested split t01a (labelling, why the ratio is fixed, unknown on top) and t01b (unknown underneath, degrees and minutes, degree mode) only if a design cannot be taught under 570 s.
